notes.title: Major updates before Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug when selecting the same stage twice
- Rebalanced Crimson Woods
- Fixed a bug when hitting esc with menus animating.
Had to rethink how the menu animation is controlled
- Fixed Golden Abyss platform that was too low on
the screen
- Increased the Golden Abyss top grid tiles Y offset
a bit
- Rebalanced the Golden Abyss stage
- Increased the water layer speed in the Zirruub
Village stage
- Changed the song text to music in the options
- Made animation when switching options in the main
menu
- Added out of bounds arrow to indicate the player
location when he is out of the screen at the top
- Added close button to options
- Changed the out of bounds arrow to be vertical
pointing up
- Updated Zirruub Village tiles
- Increased the font size of the next stage text
after beating a stage
- Added glow to main menu options, and made the
underline bar smaller
- Fixed Crimson Forest first jump being too high
- Fixed PlayerController problems
- Fixed a bug that allowed the game to be pause when
it shouldn't
- Added a new ending
- Rebalanced Neo Eclipse
- Rebalanced the player jumping
- Added difficulty levels

notes.title: Major updates
notes.content:
- Fixed end stage bosses positions with the new pacing
updates
- Fixed weird tile destruction with the new pacing
updates
- Fixed Zirruub Village's death region position at the
bottom
- Fixed a MoveToTarget script bug
- Fixed a jump in the InfiniteParallax script when the
portal with the player opens. Still moves now but it is
smoother, can't be totally fixed
- Fixed not being able to go to stage select after
beating the tutorial
- Fixed parallax moving on unpause when it shouldn't
- Fixed a bug where the death region overlay wouldn't
show up if the game is paused when the portal is opened
- Fixed loud sound closing Stage Select
- Fixed Frostfall Summit tile painting
- Updated the game fonts, and their materials
- Updated menu title image
- Added a dust effect from the player's quicksand
sinking
- Added logic to prevent pausing in some situations
- Added new main menu music
- Added new start game SFX
- Added all the new images for the new updated menu screens
- Added animations to several menus
- Added new tiles for the stages
- Added a translucent white image in front of the
backgrounds of each stage to give more contrast with the
new tiles
- Rebalanced Neo Eclipse, and Frostfall Summit
- Improved Sandstorm Serenade performance
- Optimized some parts of the game
- Updated all fonts, and materials to reflect the mockups

notes.title: New tutorial stage
notes.content:
- Added tutorial scene
- Added a tutorial handler script for logic handling
- Updated the game flow logic to account for a
tutorial
- Added new materials, music, and scripts for the tutorial
- Added new intro
- Updated the players' death explosion sound
- Updated the players' animator state machine a bit
- Updated the footsteps sound to match feet on the ground
for the player
- Fixed the player showing up alongside its explosion
- Improved the Pixel Emitter script to match better the
scene lighting
- Updated the defeated player shader to use additive
instead of color for the color mode. Also made the base
color black
- Changed the default volumes to maximum now that the
audio clips were updated

notes.title: Balancing/Pacing changes
notes.content:
- Made the default volume to be the max possible
- Reduced the difficulty a bit
- Reworked the crimson woods beginning
- Fixed villain death audio on stage looping
- Reduced the Players' box collider width so it's closer to
the ground check width
- Fixed a floating point comparison making the player
to be falling when it wasn't
- Updated the Players' speed
- Fixed progress bar content extrapolating the bar frame
- Updated the source glow dissolve on the progress bar
to use the stage color
- Fixed a bug with changing scenes playing villain
explosion

notes.title: New player death
notes.content:
Small bug fixing, new player death

    - Slowed the Player punch just a tiny bit
    - Fixed a bug where the Player could not finish
    the stage
    - Updated Player death animation
    - Fixed a bug stage selecting the same stage again
    - Fixed a bug when the death region wouldn't show
    up

notes.title: Bug fixing
notes.content:
End of stage boss fixes

        - Added a cool effect for the boss death
        - Fixed a bug not allowing the boss to get killed in some
        situations
        - Tweaked the boss shader

notes.title: Updating main character
notes.content:
Base Game/Demo

- Added the villain to the end of the Stages
- Added the villain, and main player icons to the level progress bar
- Fixed the main character animations
- Fixed the player animation state machine
- Fixed weird logic with jumping/landing on the PlayerController
- Removed a state behavior script from the fall state
- Added new materials for the villain
- Added a villain disintegration effect
- Added new SFX audio clips for the villain faceoff on each
stage
- Reworked a few scripts to use the new generic action handler
- Removed the portals from the scenes
- Improved the dissolve villain material
- Fixed an undefined reference when swapping GameObjects active
states
- Fixed player moving to the start stage area when it shouldn't
- Fixed infinite parallax scrolling stopping under certain
conditions
